rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is sufficient to meet a need or requirement.

example.english: We have enough staff to adequately handle today's customers.
example.traditional: 我哋有夠人手應付今日啲客。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 gau3 jan4 sau2 jing3 fu6 gam1 jat6 di1 haak3

rows.note: Use this mainly when saying that something has been handled properly or satisfactorily, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The matter has been adequately handled.
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 to5 sin6 cyu5 lei5
